reviewed_by: Codex focused review for blocked hook model feedback
reason: Blocking provider hooks should inform the model without bypassing the block. Six new Python cases verify start-hook feedback, effectful completion-hook feedback without replay, real command-hook denial, bounded and redacted feedback, and delivery to the next provider request. Nineteen existing hook-turn and payload cases check completion, streaming, failure, and cancellation regressions. Five research-result cases cover formatting-only files needed by the tree-wide CI format gate. The selected real-Core browser journey now sends a blocked start-hook turn through the UI and verifies model feedback, failed outcome, and reload on desktop and emulated mobile browsers.
exclusions: No frontend application or native source changed, so those unit layers are empty. Unrelated command, provider, and browser journeys and all full suites are excluded. Formatting-only files have no behavior changes. The browser journey covers blocked start-hook feedback; effectful completion and command-hook feedback are covered at the Core boundary by Python tests. Physical devices are unavailable in this environment.
